## Checklist

- [ ] Formatting verified (`scripts/format.sh --check` or `scripts/format.ps1 -Check`)
- [ ] Tests cover the change, or this PR explains why none are needed
- [ ] Documentation updated where behavior or structure changed
- [ ] Architecturally significant decision → ADR added under `docs/adr/`
- [ ] Rejected an alternative worth remembering → entry under `docs/failed-ideas/`
